programmes.name_en: Israel Innovation Authority - Ideation (Tnufa) Incentive Program
programmes.amount_note: Grant of up to 85% of an approved budget capped at about ILS 200,000 (historically ILS 100,000-200,000 depending on the track) for early entrepreneurs to build an initial prototype, protect IP and validate the business concept.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling submissions through the Innovation Authority's online system, with periodic committee sittings.

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the Israel Innovation Authority online system.
Submit the Tnufa application with a technical and commercial plan and budget.
Professional evaluation and committee decision.
Grant approval, milestone reporting and reimbursement of approved expenditure.

eligibility.other_note: Open to individual entrepreneurs and very early companies; applicant must be an Israeli resident or company. Royalties are payable to the state on resulting revenue.

programmes.source_snippet: The funds will be used for building an initial prototype, intellectual property protection and business development plans

programmes.name_en: Israel Innovation Authority - Innovation Labs Program
programmes.amount_note: Startups admitted to a licensed corporate innovation lab receive Authority grants of up to 85% of an approved budget (historically up to roughly ILS 1 million) plus access to the corporate's infrastructure, data and expertise.
programmes.deadline_note: Startups apply directly to the individual licensed labs, which run their own intake cycles; the Authority issues periodic calls to license new labs.

procedure_steps.detail: Identify a licensed innovation lab matching your sector.
Apply to that lab's intake.
Lab selects the startup and co-submits to the Authority.
Grant approval and lab residency.

eligibility.other_note: Israeli companies; the sponsoring corporate provides infrastructure and may take an option on the technology.

programmes.name_en: Israel Innovation Authority - MOFET manufacturing R&D accelerators
programmes.amount_note: A programme to create R&D accelerators inside the manufacturing industry, fostering innovation in traditional industrial firms. Grant rates and ceilings are set in the specific call.
programmes.deadline_note: Announced as a new programme; operating calls and their budgets are published on the Innovation Authority programme page.
programmes.reopen_note: The Authority described MOFET as a new programme designed to create R&D accelerators in the manufacturing industry. Watch innovationisrael.org.il/en/programs/ for the operative call for proposals.

procedure_steps.detail: Monitor the Innovation Authority programme page for the MOFET call.
Apply as an accelerator operator or as a participating manufacturer/startup.
Evaluation and award.

eligibility.other_note: Targets collaboration between startups and Israeli manufacturing industry.

programmes.source_snippet: Israel Innovation Authority is launching a new program designed to create R&D in the manufacturing industry ("MOFET") accelerators to foster innovation

programmes.name_en: Israel Innovation Authority - R&D Fund (Growth Division)
programmes.amount_note: The flagship R&D grant: 20-50% of an approved R&D budget (with an extra 10 percentage points for companies in national development priority zones). There is no fixed cap; the budget is approved per project. Royalties of 3-5% of revenue are repayable up to the grant amount plus interest.
programmes.deadline_note: The R&D Fund operates with periodic submission cut-offs published by the Authority (historically several per year) rather than fully continuous intake.

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the Innovation Authority online system.
Submit the R&D plan and budget before the cut-off date.
Professional and economic evaluation.
Research committee decision; grant approved with royalty obligations and IP restrictions.

eligibility.other_note: Israeli-registered companies. Know-how developed with the grant may generally not be transferred out of Israel without Authority approval and payment.

programmes.name_en: Israel Innovation Authority - Startup Fund (early-stage companies)
programmes.amount_note: Grants covering up to 50% (and up to 75% in some priority tracks) of an approved R&D budget for young companies that have raised limited capital, commonly up to several million shekels over a two-year plan.
programmes.deadline_note: Submissions are accepted against periodic cut-off dates published by the Authority.

procedure_steps.detail: Confirm the company meets the early-stage thresholds (limited prior fundraising and revenue).
Submit the two-year R&D plan through the Authority's system before a cut-off.
Evaluation and committee decision.
Grant with milestone reporting and royalty obligations.

eligibility.other_note: Israeli companies below defined thresholds for capital raised and revenue; exact thresholds are updated by the Authority each year.

programmes.name_en: Israel Innovation Authority - Technological Incubators Program
programmes.amount_note: Portfolio companies in a licensed incubator receive Innovation Authority grants covering up to 85% of an approved budget, historically up to roughly ILS 3.5 million over two years for deep-tech ventures, with the incubator investing the balance.
programmes.deadline_note: Companies apply to a licensed incubator at any time; the Authority separately issues periodic competitive calls to license new incubator franchises (a call for up to three new deep-tech venture incubators was issued in the 2025 cycle).
programmes.reopen_note: Incubator franchise concessions are awarded through competitive calls published on innovationisrael.org.il; startups do not apply to those calls but to the incubators themselves.

procedure_steps.detail: Approach a licensed technological incubator with the venture.
Incubator screens and selects the project.
Joint application to the Innovation Authority for the grant.
Grant approval; incubator invests alongside and hosts the company.

eligibility.other_note: Israeli company incubated by a licensed incubator; the incubator takes equity. Royalty obligations apply.

programmes.source_snippet: 'Ideation' ('Tnufa') fund for promoting ideation among entrepreneurs: a budget of NIS 250,000 with an 80% grant rate
